brands.name: Ron Wade Surfboards
brands.location_label: Mona Vale, New South Wales, Australia
brands.short_description: Australian-made shortboards, mid-lengths, and longboards from Ron Wade in Mona Vale — Blackfeather, F1-11, and classic logs.

models.name: Blackfeather
models.description: Our Black Feather model is available as a Thruster whilst the 5 fin configuration can also be used as a Quad. Slight concaves running from just in front of the fins helps loosen the tail and acceleration out of a turn. This board is suitable for small to medium size waves. Fins included.

models.name: F1-11
models.description: This F1-11 model has the Five fin configuration, so you can use it as a Thruster or Quad or use the 5 Fins for larger surf conditions. We have put dual concaves from in front of the fins to loosen the tail making it a very versatile board. The board has a very high polish finish which is very labour intensive. Shaped and designed by Ron.

models.name: F1-11 Twin
models.description: Sky blue deck and Mid blue bottom, with dual pin lines around the deck. Highly polished, very labour intensive. A great board for surfing waves between 3ft to around 6 ft. Shaped and designed by Ron.

models.name: Longboard
models.description: Slight scoop in the nose feeding back into dual concaves through the tail area. This will loosen the tail up making it highly maneuverable board. Shaped and designed by Ron.

models.name: Mid-Length
models.description: 3 stage bottom, medium tail lift with dual concaves running through to the tail. Thruster fin set up. Glossed with a high polished finish. Shaped and designed by Ron.
